description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes used by the mock backend and Retrofit interface for the Android app, representing request and response models for authentication and protected resource access.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login request containing username and password.

classes.name: RefreshRequest
classes.description: DTO for token refresh request containing refresh token.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: DTO for token response containing access and refresh tokens, and token expiry time.

classes.name: ProtectedResponse
classes.description: DTO for responses from protected endpoints containing a message.
